name: 75231 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75231 (Dallas) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75231 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
